method: Labels by an AI assistant (the Claude Code session that ran T60), reading each claim and each record's title, publication types and abstract (first ~450 characters) once, with no model API call. Not human labels and not inter-annotator agreement: one labeller, to be spot-checked by the lead (start with least_sure). Scale: 2 = tests the claim (this intervention/exposure and this outcome, in humans); 1 = partly relevant human evidence the verifier could use (a close exposure or outcome, a narrower population, or a review that addresses the question); 0 = not evidence for the claim (off-topic, animal, cell or mechanistic work, chemistry, opinion without content). Labelled before either scorer's scores were looked at; the MedCPT weights were still downloading.
